key_insight: Neural operator-based surrogates can effectively model CFD-level transient analysis for helical coil steam generators in small modular reactors.
engineering_relevance: This research enhances real-time thermal-hydraulic simulation capabilities crucial for the operation of small modular reactors.
method: Combines reduced-order model (ROM) with neural operators for CFD analysis.
Utilizes MLP-based autoencoder for unstructured mesh and convolutional autoencoder for structured mesh data.
Implements a multi-scale technique to improve prediction accuracy.
evidence_signal: The multi-scale L-DeepONet accurately captured periodic vortex dynamics and the FNO provided reliable pressure drop estimates.
watch_item: Care should be taken in model selection based on specific CFD data types and flow resolution requirements.
paper_title: Neural Operator-Based Surrogate Model for CFD:Helical Coil Steam Generator in Small Modular Reactor
